evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive issued as a standing mandate — authority of position setting an ongoing cadence.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Logical equivalence framed as a maxim — supplying the factual premise that justifies the mandate.
Restates the cadence as an established fact of process — authority of agreed process.
Self-assignment of the owner role — authority of position claimed by labeling.
